This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 3 of 3, in date order). It is the current text.
* '''Playtest''' ([[Coruscant: 500 Republica (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscant500republica.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Corsucant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.”
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: 500 Republica]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscant500republica.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Corsucant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.” '''What changed:''' before release: the art credit “Image approval of DanOcean@Deviantart pending” became “Image courtesy of DanOcean@Deviantart”, the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added, and the card was re-rendered with sharper graphics; same words (including the misspelling “Corsucant”). On 2 August 2019 the PC re-uploaded the same image turned 90° (Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190802-d24ffc3.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscant500republica.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark). Turned back, it is the same image with the same words, so it is not a separate version (an image that only re-orients a printing is a note on that printing; Bill, 25 November 2026).
*: [[File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): '''First published 29 March 2023''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/coruscant500republica.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/168657ac16eea2f516349595d99cda7cd8f849f3 commit 168657a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/coruscant500republica.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Coruscant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: the misspelling “Corsucant: Private Platform” became “Coruscant: Private Platform”; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”). '''PC transcription error:''' the words changed but the card prints no errata mark (this is errata version 2 by release order, PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
*: [[File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
